characters.voice_style: Nostalgic male narrator, warm and reflective, slight rasp of experience, speaks with reverence for the old days. Starts heavy and broken in hook, builds warmth during origin, sharpens with pride during empire-building, drops to devastation during scam, rebuilds quiet determination, finishes with earned confidence.

story_arc.hook: I lost everything in Growtopia. My world, my items, my reputation. But that's not how my story ends.
story_arc.origin: Started as a noob with nothing. First day, someone gave me a World Lock. Changed my life forever.
story_arc.turning_point: Built an empire. Thousands of worlds. Then the great scam took it all — Crown, Wings, Locks, years of work, gone.
story_arc.revelation: Came back with nothing but knowledge. Built it all again. Now richer than ever. The real treasure in Growtopia is knowledge.

environments_used: Beginner world with basic blocks and a single small tree
Bustling trade world with vending machines and display boxes
Empty devastated world with broken blocks and cracked ground
Grand rebuilt world with pixel-art castle, fountains, and Diamond Lock display cases

characters.name: Stormcaller
characters.role: an original Growtopia player character built from the Zeus set — a nobody farmer struck by legendary lightning who ascends, lets power go to his head, nearly loses it in a storm backlash, and ends up sharing it as a mentor to newcomers

costume_stages.mortal: 2D pixel-art Growtopian, blocky humanoid, tan/beige blocky skin (~#C9A67C), large square head, two white dot eyes with black pupils, small flat mouth, thick clean black outline, plain brown work shirt, patched grey trousers, dirt-stained tiny blocky hands, no hat, no cosmetic set, humble slim build, holding a wooden hoe, eager but weary expression

characters.voice_style: Male narrator, mythic and self-aware. Starts wry and a little shaken (post-crisis hook), warms into plain humility during origin, swells with cocky pride during the Zeus ascension and hubris beats, cracks with alarm during the storm backlash, settles into a warm grounded mentor tone for the revelation.

story_arc.hook: I'm Stormcaller — the Growtopian chosen by Zeus's own lightning. I nearly lost everything it gave me.
story_arc.origin: Before the storm, I was nobody. Just a farmer breaking blocks for gems, world after world.
story_arc.turning_point: Lightning found me and the Zeus set became mine. Power went to my head — I flaunted my crown and mocked players who had nothing. Then the storm turned on me and nearly tore the crown from my hands.
story_arc.revelation: Now I share the storm instead of hoarding it. Every newbie I meet gets a spark of it.

environments_used: Open storm-lashed field with a single dead tree
Bustling tile-block trade plaza with vending machines and World Lock display cases
Cracked floating-platform storm world under a jagged lightning sky

narrator.register: young teen boy (~13), NOT an adult man; light youthful timbre, warm, reflective first-person. Casual_Guy/Young_Knight/Deep_Voice_Man read too adult for a child narrator (burned 2026-07-17).
narrator.note: No approved Chatterbox sample owned by this bible. The default skin is the nameless everyplayer, so voice identity is not critical — MiniMax narration is acceptable per user authorization.
